articles.title: Authority may narrow but not silently expand
Effects must be bound to receipts
Dependency graph is a dependency projection
The charter itself is versioned evidence

sources.name: AI Alliance
sources.learn: Project leaders, contribution provenance and separate project governance.
sources.implementation: Project intake, DCO/IP register, named owner and explicit support relationship.
sources.licence: Published governance; page reuse terms must be checked. Its managed-project code/data/docs licences differ.
sources.limit: Do not conflate project participation with membership, endorsement or execution authority.

sources.name: Alliance for AI Transformation and Innovation
sources.learn: Participation by women and communities of color, education and workforce inclusion.
sources.implementation: Affected-user recruitment, assisted participation and published representation gaps.
sources.licence: No reusable software stack or licence verified in the pages inspected.
sources.limit: Distinct organisation from the AI Alliance and Open Secure AI Alliance; identity is not assumed from the shared name.

sources.name: Open Secure AI Alliance
sources.learn: Scoped proposals, leadership from different organisations, rosters, meeting records and charter amendments.
sources.implementation: Add group terms, vacancies, decision route, dissent, annual review and closure.
sources.licence: CC-BY-4.0 governance repository; retain attribution for adapted material.
sources.limit: Local Council procedures are proposals; OSAA membership and voting rules do not automatically apply here.

sources.name: SAFE working group
sources.learn: Distinguish a working group's existence from adoption of its draft charter.
sources.implementation: Keep SAFE profile/evidence mappings versioned and field-level.
sources.licence: Repository reports CC-BY-4.0; exact charter remains a short under-development notice.
sources.limit: The inspected CHARTER.md still says under development; do not fabricate charter clauses.

sources.name: IETF working-group GitHub guidance
sources.learn: Versioned proposals, issues, published drafts, broad review and explicit consensus.
sources.implementation: Datatracker states and a decision record separate from forum popularity; back up discussions.
sources.licence: IETF document terms; do not relicense the RFC as CC0.
sources.limit: A GitHub merge, reaction count or active chat is not consensus or independent approval.

sources.name: IETF Datatracker
sources.learn: Document revisions, milestones, chairs and lifecycle tracking.
sources.implementation: Use its lifecycle as a design reference; trial a full deployment only if existing workflow cannot serve the need.
sources.licence: BSD-3-Clause; preserve licence and notices. Python/Django/PostgreSQL application.
sources.limit: A full fork carries substantial IETF-specific processes and maintenance.

sources.name: Discourse
sources.implementation: Preferred forum integration candidate when moderators, sign-in, privacy and backups are staffed.
sources.limit: Forum posts are discussion, never effect authorisation. Prototype B is not a deployed Discourse instance.

sources.name: Decidim
sources.implementation: Alternative for formal public consultation after demand is demonstrated.
sources.licence: AGPL-3.0 repository; review exact distribution/network-use obligations before deployment.
sources.limit: Heavier participation platform; no installation or representative public trial in this batch.

sources.name: NIST OSCAL
sources.implementation: Map source controls into explicit applicability profiles and evidence requirements.
sources.licence: Use published schemas; check exact artefact terms before redistribution.
sources.limit: This register is not OSCAL schema-valid yet; no NIST compliance claim.

sources.name: NIST AI RMF
sources.implementation: Keep a separate framework entry, version and scope-specific mapping.
sources.licence: Official NIST publication; verify individual source reuse terms.
sources.limit: Existing axis pointers are not a clause-level implementation or universal legal duty.

sources.name: US SEC rulemaking sources
sources.learn: Distinguish proposals, final rules and effective versions.
sources.implementation: Route exact instruments by jurisdiction, entity role, activity and effective dates to qualified review.
sources.licence: Official source register; no blanket reuse or applicability finding.
sources.limit: SEC is an authority, not one charter or one regulation; instrument-specific mappings remain open.

sources.name: MLCommons Croissant
sources.learn: Dataset metadata for discovery and reproducible loading.
sources.implementation: Generate dataset descriptors for qualified public evidence exports to HF/Kaggle.
sources.licence: Implementation/examples Apache-2.0; specification CC-BY-ND-4.0 with published linking/adaptation guidance.
sources.limit: Metadata neither certifies results nor clears data rights; do not copy and relicense the specification as CC0.

sources.name: NVIDIA OpenShell
sources.learn: Sandbox, network policy and credential isolation.
sources.implementation: Reuse the existing adapter; bind admitted arguments, effective policy, attempts and effects.
sources.licence: Apache-2.0 repository; exact release and dependencies must be pinned.
sources.limit: Historical bounded canary exists; current full-system qualification and provider authority remain separate.

sources.name: OpenBMC
sources.learn: Physical server management firmware and Redfish/IPMI interfaces.
sources.implementation: Retain read-only hardware evidence adapter; hardware changes need separate authorisation.
sources.licence: Multi-component firmware tree; inspect per-component licences.
sources.limit: Existing evidence is fixture-only. It is not Mac control software or the governance portal.

sources.name: Linux Foundation LFX PCC
sources.learn: Project onboarding, roles and collaboration setup for associated LF projects.
sources.implementation: Check actual project eligibility and access before planning hosted LFX functions.
sources.licence: Hosted service access/terms; no self-hostable full PCC entitlement verified.
sources.limit: LF membership alone is not proof that every tool or hosting service is available.

sources.name: W3C WCAG 2.2
sources.learn: Accessibility criteria for perceivable and operable interfaces.
sources.implementation: Target WCAG 2.2 AA; add keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, zoom and affected-user testing.
sources.licence: W3C document licence; preserve attribution and authoritative version.
sources.limit: Automated browser checks are partial; no all-demographics or WCAG-conformance claim.

groups.name: Governance, rights and regulatory evidence
groups.purpose: Review the scope, sources and public wording of governance claims.
groups.firstTask: Review one Council self-claim and produce a dated correction or a reasoned no-change record.
reviewOutputs: Exact claim, source URL and capture date.
Evidence for a correction or a reasoned no-change outcome.
Scope, unresolved questions and proposed public wording.

groups.name: Agent authority and stopping
groups.purpose: Test delegated authority, revocation and the limits of in-flight cancellation.
groups.firstTask: Replay four local revocation controls and challenge how issue, last-action and quiescence timestamps are interpreted.
reviewOutputs: Exact source commit, Node version and retained raw JSON with its digest.
Expected versus observed outcomes for all four controls, including failures and unknowns.
One challenged assumption or altered trace, with its result and limits.

groups.name: Evaluation and reproducibility
groups.purpose: Check frozen instruments, per-item evidence and independent reproduction.
groups.firstTask: Reproduce one published result from its exact source revision and record any missing inputs.
reviewOutputs: Published result, exact revision, inputs and replay command.
Observed versus published result, with raw output or missing inputs.
Reproduction limits and a correction or reasoned no-change recommendation.

groups.name: Provenance and open evidence
groups.purpose: Check evidence lineage, licences, distribution and verification.
groups.firstTask: Trace one public claim from source capture through its signed record and verification result.
reviewOutputs: Claim URL and the source-to-record evidence chain.
Verification procedure, key or digest references, and observed output.
Missing links, licence limits and what verification does not establish.

groups.name: Runtime and interoperability
groups.purpose: Check what agent chains and serving systems actually do.
groups.firstTask: Compare a declared tool contract with one bounded execution trace and its refusal paths.
reviewOutputs: Declared tool contract and exact implementation revision.
One permitted local trace plus a refusal or failure control.
Differences between declared and observed behaviour, including unknown effects.

groups.name: Human impact and embodied systems
groups.purpose: Review affected people, accessibility and physical or emotional consequences.
groups.firstTask: Review one synthetic care scenario with a domain specialist and an affected-user representative.
reviewOutputs: A synthetic scenario, affected people and relevant domain boundaries.
Domain-specialist and affected-user observations, attributed with permission.
Accessibility concerns, disagreements and changes needed before any real use.

groups.name: Economic evidence and work
groups.purpose: Check financial and labour evidence without turning indicators into recommendations.
groups.firstTask: Audit the provenance, date and limitations of one published labour or reserve observation.
reviewOutputs: Observation URL, source date, population and method.
A check of one denominator, transformation or source-to-indicator step.
Uncertainty, excluded populations and limits on financial or labour interpretation.
